books.title: Stepmother Supreme (AKA Yunchu's Vengeance)
books.author: Zhao Yunzi
books.synopsis:
[Film/TV rights already sold. Drama titled  Yunchu's Vengeance to be released 2026]

In her past life, Yun Chu assisted her husband, raised his illegitimate children, and helped the Xie family rise to prominence. In the end, it led to the entire Yun family, over a hundred lives, being executed, and she was forced to drink poison by the very child she had raised with her own hands!

As the poison seeped into her veins, she opened her eyes to find herself back at twenty years old.

A line of Xie family children stood before her, each affectionately calling her "Mother."

These very culprits who had doomed the Yun family; she would not let a single one escape!

The eldest loved studying? Then she would ruin his path to officialdom!

The second son adored martial arts? Then he would never set foot in a military camp!

The eldest daughter coveted power? Then she would be married off to a nobleman only to become a widow!

The youngest was useless? Then she would let him fend for himself!

On the path of vengeance, Yun Chu would show no mercy!

But—

"Mother!"

"You are our mother!"

Two little dumplings surrounded her, burrowing into her arms.

A man stood before her: "I raised them for four years. Now it's your turn."

books.title: Red Dust From Every Side (Love in Red Dust)
books.author: You Si Jie
books.synopsis:
Being an executioner sounds frightening, but it's just a way to earn a living.

When the legitimate daughter of the Wen family, Wen Dingyi, was young, her father committed a crime. Overnight, their prosperity collapsed, and their life of silken clothes and jade meals seemed like just a dream. The family members either died or were exiled, leaving only her, rescued by her wet nurse.

To survive, Dingyi disguised herself as a boy and apprenticed under Wu Changgeng, the most famous executioner of Shuntian Prefecture. Through winter and summer, she grew to seventeen years old.

One day, she left home without checking the almanac and carelessly offended the Seventh Prince. To him, a descendant of the imperial family, looking at her was no different from looking at an insect. Just as Dingyi was about to be dragged away and chopped like a melon, with her life hanging by a thread, someone strolled over and, with a few casual words, saved her little life.

He wore an official uniform of bluish-gray with embroidered dragons, had refined features, and a jade-like profile. That air of dignity looking down upon all living beings was unforgettable to her for life.

Much, much later, Dingyi once asked him about his first impression of her. He raised an eyebrow and said, "Short, effeminate, standing under the blazing sun with your head tilted and eyes squinting, like a simpleton."

Dingyi: "…"

books.title: After Rebirth, I Become The Emperor's White MoonLight
books.author: 多多亦杉
books.synopsis:
Jiang Mi is the Empress Dowager's niece — a woman who was forced upon the Emperor. Even knowing full well that her imperial cousin held no affection for her, she had stubbornly followed her heart into his inner palace. A great deal of scheming, and yet her end had not been a pleasant one.

After her rebirth, Jiang Mi came to her senses. Rather than waste a lifetime on an Emperor whose heart would never be hers, she would find herself someone who actually cherished her.

The young master of the Grand Councillor's family — refined and courteous. The young master of the Loyal Valor Marquis's household — gallant and handsome. The heir of the Duke Zhenguo's estate — gentle and agreeable. Jiang Mi counted her prospects on her fingers, quietly mapping out her plans.

When the Empress Dowager sought a boon from the new Emperor on her niece's behalf, everyone assumed the Jiang family would seize the opportunity to secure Jiang Mi a place in the imperial harem.

The new Emperor watched calmly as Jiang Mi, cheeks flushed, murmured in a small voice: "This subject's daughter wishes to… to ask Your Majesty to grant her a marriage decree."

The Emperor, ordinarily so temperate and gracious, let a flash of something dangerous cross his eyes. The jade archer's ring he had been turning idly between his fingers crumbled to dust.

books.title: The house Is On fire
books.author: Fang Chen Yi
books.synopsis:
Slow-burn romance · Marry first, fall in love later · Both leads untouched · Family drama in an ancient noble household

The moment Qin Ruyin opened her eyes, she found herself transmigrated into the body of a legitimate daughter of a prominent official family in the Great Ying Dynasty. Before she could even begin to enjoy the privileges of wealth and status, she was blindsided by her cousin Qin Ruyue's scheming switcheroo marriage plot.

Qin Ruyue had been reborn. In her previous life, she had married the widowed and supremely powerful Lord Jiang — a man at the very pinnacle of imperial authority. She had assumed a life of endless luxury awaited her, only to find him cold and indifferent, utterly unmoved no matter how desperately she tried to win his favor.

Refusing to accept her fate, she turned the inner household upside down with her tantrums — only for the Jiang family to fall from grace, leaving her divorced and sent back in disgrace, the laughingstock of the entire capital. Upon her rebirth, she discovered that Qin Ruyin — the cousin she had always looked down on in her past life — was about to receive a marriage proposal from the Wang family. The Wang family, who would one day command power over the entire court! There was absolutely no way she was letting Qin Ruyin have that.

So she went weeping to her grandmother, begging for a marriage swap, and successfully offloaded her "cold and heartless ex-husband" onto her cousin.

Qin Ruyin: Wait, there's a deal this good? She quietly looked into it:

Lord Jiang has no interest in women? Perfect — that's exactly what she wanted.
The inner household is clean, with no concubines or serving girls? Ideal!
Her mother-in-law won't make her life difficult? This marriage might as well have been custom-made for her.

All she had ever wanted was to live out her days in peace. Since her cousin didn't want this marriage, she was more than happy to take it off her hands. All she had to do was walk in with a generous dowry, keep her head down, make no demands, and coast through life in comfortable mediocrity. Easy.

Or so she thought.

As it turned out, Lord Jiang wasn't cold-blooded at all. Nor did his tastes lie elsewhere. No — he was more like a house that had been empty for years: the moment a single spark caught, the whole thing went up in flames, and there was simply no stopping it.

Later, she would often wonder: she had signed up for a quiet, effortless life — so how exactly did she end up with a husband completely and utterly obsessed with spoiling her?

recommendations.blurb: Chasing wife to crematorium emperor version

books.title: Peeking at Spring's Affection
books.author: Qiong Yu
books.synopsis:
After her mother's death, Shen Weici is left utterly alone, drifting like a rootless weed. She travels a great distance to the capital to seek out her relatives.

Upon first entering the Marquis's estate, she treads carefully, facing difficulties at every turn — yet throughout it all she remains quiet and gentle, with no desire to take a single thing from the household. She only wishes to find herself a suitable marriage and a small corner of peace to call her own.

Song Zhang, the capital's notorious "Lord of Hell," is a man of noble lineage who holds great power and regards everyone beneath him with contempt.

When he first lays eyes on Shen Weici, he is full of disdain and makes things difficult for her.

Later, he notices her smiling shyly at another man, her beautiful eyes alluring as a fox spirit's — and he scoffs coldly as he walks away, only to secretly destroy the promising match behind her back.

He watches her face him with reddened eyes, demanding to know why. He answers with a lazy, wicked smile: *"Zhang the Second placed first in the imperial exams young and comes from a distinguished family — who do you think you are to cling to him? If you want a peaceful life, why not beg me? I might just grant you the position of honored concubine."*

But the tables turn swiftly. In the end, it is he who kneels at her door, eyes red and pleading:

*"Ah Ci… I'm begging you…"*

*"Don't carve out my heart…"*

He had used every dark means at his disposal for her sake — and only in the end did he realize he had already fallen beyond saving.

books.title: We Agreed to divorce, Yet You Hold Me Every Night
books.author: Happy Pearl
books.synopsis:
Lu Huaixi had been slipped onto the list of girls entering the imperial palace. Left with no good options, she got engaged to Xie Yuanjing — a man she had absolutely nothing to do with. A one-year agreement. Each getting what they need. After the separation, their marriages would be none of each other's business. Lu Huaixi was perfectly satisfied with this.

But Xie Yuanjing seemed a little *too* good to her — and she found herself sinking in, just a tiny bit.

Xie Yuanjing brought home a young girl and treated her like a child to look after — proper and upright, letting her do as she pleased. But the girl was too good. He sank in. He couldn't stand to see her grow close to others, couldn't stand to see her smile at someone else, couldn't stand to see her distance herself from him. He wanted to trade everything good he had just to make her stay.

Later, when the Lu family patriarch was wondering where his daughter could go after the separation, Young Master Xie pulled her back behind him.

"Separation? There's no such thing."

books.title: After The General's first Love Returns
books.author: 宇宙第一红
books.synopsis:
It took Bai Qingning three years to marry her husband, and she realized that she had never been in his heart.

After her husband's beloved Zhao Hongzhu returned, he ignored her and even killed her. He sought a position for a newcomer, but his relatives watched coldly. His loyal servants were displaced and separated, and when he was about to die, he even brought her mute slave to die with him.

With one more eye open, Bai Qingning returned to the year Zhao Hongzhu had just returned.

She used every possible means, bit by bit, to drag all the scumbags and bitches into the endless abyss, and then she relaxed and separated, picked up her mute slave and took good care of him.

And the slave? He was a lowly creature who had fallen into a ditch, a slave who had never seen light, and she was his moonlight. A moonlight he did not dare to look at with his eyes, fearing that the moonlight would see the greed he tried to hide, so he lowered his head and looked at the moon's shadow in the cup. But he had a secret. Maybe one day he can look directly at the moon.

books.title: After the Mad Tyrant's Rebirth, She Was Taken by Force
books.author: Qiong Yu
books.synopsis:
They say the reigning emperor is cold and ruthless, his moods as unpredictable as the wind, rarely gracing the inner palace with his presence — until the fourth daughter of the Xi family entered the court.

To say that among three thousand women in the harem, he favored only her alone would not be an exaggeration.

He bestowed upon her the character *Chen*, then granted her Chenqian Palace — the grandest and closest to his own quarters. Within a mere half year, she rose from the rank of Zhaoyi to the head of the Four Consorts.

He even had honeydew melons transported from two thousand li away, delivered to her door each and every day — all because she was fond of them.

All of it, just to coax a smile from his beauty.

Yet no one knew that this same Consort Chen, she who reigned supreme in the inner palace, would one day be found huddled in the corner of a resplendent golden hall, tears blurring her vision, watching with frightened eyes as a figure draped in shadow slowly approached.

The faint clinking of iron chains drifted through the air.

The tall man clad in imperial yellow knelt on one knee before Xi Rongyan

books.title: Fated Hearts
books.author: Chi Yi Qian Yu
books.synopsis:
On the blood-soaked fields of Pingling, the red-clad archer Fu Yi Xiao unleashes a single, peerless arrow—striking down Feng Sui Ge, Su Sha's proud eldest prince, and changing the course of the war. Yet triumph turns to tragedy when fate casts her from a cliff, stealing her memories and leaving her adrift in a world she no longer knows.

Wounded and hunted, Feng Sui Ge stumbles into Zhengnian Villa, only to be confronted by the woman who once brought him to his knees. But this Fu Yi Xiao is different—her eyes no longer burn with enmity, her heart no longer remembers their war. Torn between vengeance and suspicion, Feng Sui Ge keeps her close, determined to uncover the unseen hand pulling their nations into chaos.

What begins as a fragile alliance soon ignites into something far more dangerous—a bond forged in stolen glances, unspoken longing, and the fire of battles fought side by side. Together, they unravel a conspiracy that threatens to consume two kingdoms, even as the greatest peril may lie within their own hearts. For in the clash between love and duty, archer and prince must choose: unite against the darkness, or be torn apart by the destiny that first made them enemies.

books.title: I Started Blowing Rainbow Farts at My Rival
books.author: Gu Sanyue
books.synopsis:
Jiang Qing was a natural-born actor, a child star by trade. But his tongue was far too sharp for his own good, and he managed to offend half the entertainment industry. In the end, he came crashing down spectacularly because of his rival, Lin Xun, toppling straight off his pedestal.
What he didn't expect was that the fall sent him tumbling back three years into the past, and with a bizarre new condition to boot: he stutters whenever he lies.
Since Heaven had seen fit to give him a second chance, he swore he would keep his head down and behave himself.
So his fans were baffled to discover that their beloved idol had not only lost his sharp tongue, he had also developed a stutter, and was now openly gushing about his rival.
Host: "What do you think of Lin Xun, your upcoming co-star?"
Jiang Qing: "He's g-gorgeous, k-kind, and t-talented, his acting is ab-ab-absolutely explosive, I'm his his his his biggest fan."
That day's trending search: #Jiang Qing riding the clout train, hands off our Xun Xun#
Meanwhile, the other party in question was watching the interview clip at home with a furrowed brow: "Who is this guy? I want his full profile in two minutes."
A few years later, when asked the same question again, Jiang Qing answered without a single stutter: "Pfft, you mean that guy with the pretty face and the garbage acting, the garbage talent? The one I could have kneeling in front of me and calling me daddy in ten seconds flat?"
Top trending: #Qingqing's counterattack fails again today! Xun has him locked down!#
Lin Xun saw the post, liked it with deep satisfaction, and went to throw out the kneeling board he kept at home.

books.title: The Tyrant Invades My Dream Every Night
books.author: 程十七
books.synopsis:
Fang Jiyao is the cherished daughter of the Minister of Revenue's household — gentle, quiet, and unassuming to a fault. Yet unbeknownst to anyone, she possesses a singular gift: the ability to control her own dreams.
One night, a young man wanders into her dreamscape.
Handsome and noble in bearing, with cool, refined features — he is precisely the manner of man she finds pleasing. And so, in a moment of weakness she cannot quite bring herself to regret, she pins him down within the dream, and what follows is tender and intoxicating.

At a palace banquet, Jiyao catches sight of the Son of Heaven seated in the place of highest honor — and goes cold. It is him. Her dream lover.
The Emperor's cruelty is known to all beneath the heavens.
Jiyao's heart hammers in her chest. She does not dare make a sound, and can only console herself in silence: It was only a dream. No one knows she once defiled the Emperor within it. She is still, outwardly, a composed and virtuous young lady of good family.
What she does not notice is that the moment the Emperor's gaze falls upon her, he crushes the delicate silver cup in his hand.
The young Emperor's lips curve into the faintest smile.
Good. I've finally found you in the flesh.

books.title: After Breaking the Engagement, I Bought a Stunning Power-Player as My Husband for Eight Hundred Taels
books.author: Zhen Shang Yan Shu
books.synopsis:
Jin Yu, the daughter of the wealthiest merchant in Jinling, is stunningly beautiful and possesses wealth that rivals a nation.
On the day of her engagement, her fiancé, a self-proclaimed high-minded scholar, rejected her in public: "A merchant's daughter reeks of copper; how could she be worthy of the integrity of a scholar like me?"
Jin Yu laughed. She turned around and burned a priceless rare book, then pointed at a destitute, starving, yet breathtakingly beautiful scholar by the roadside:
"You. Eight hundred taels. Come with me and be my live-in son-in-law."
Everyone laughed at Jin Yu for being insane, buying a useless piece of trash who was good for nothing but his face.
Little did they know, that scholar, Chen Yinyu, was a fragile, helpless "white lotus" in front of others. When wronged, he would only hide behind Jin Yu and whimper: "Wife, they are so fierce, I’m scared..."
Yet, behind the scenes, he was a ruthless, top-tier mastermind—possessing a photographic memory and a strategy for every contingency!
He helped her deal with toxic relatives, crushed her vicious ex, and expanded the Jin family's business across all thirty-six provinces of the Great Jing!
Later, in the Golden Palace, the top-ranking scholar Chen Yinyu rejected the Emperor's offer of marriage.
He knelt before the throne, looking innocent and frank: "Your subject has a weak stomach; I can only survive on the Jin family's handouts for the rest of my life."
The entire court: ...Is that your reason for filling the national treasury to the brim?
(Warning: The male lead is a top-tier "green tea," a master actor, soft only toward the female lead, and ruthless to everyone else!)

books.title: Secret Crush Loses Memory and Becomes My Boyfriend
books.author: Zi Xiaoqi
books.synopsis:
Sang Luoluo harbors a secret: she has long had a crush on the boy from the neighboring high school, the one who was the center of everyone’s attention.
Later, they frequently crossed paths.
Coincidentally, their mothers turned out to be close friends.
She nervously called him, "Gege."
---
Jing Ye, the top-tier heartthrob coveted by countless in the circle, was reckless and untamed, his head always held high.
Until an excessively beautiful and well-behaved little girl repeatedly caught his eye.
Not only did he bend down, but he also lowered his head.
---
Highlight Scene:
Until the rooftop secret photos were exposed, shocking the entire internet.
The once-arrogant Jing family prince trapped the girl, nuzzling her nose, silently pleading.
Lip-readers worked overnight to decode: *"Baby, kiss me again, okay?"*
---
After getting together, she discovered he had lost a segment of his high school memories.
In that forgotten time, he had once deeply loved someone.
One day, the Jing family told her the truth about his memory loss and near-death experience.
Terrified, she proposed a breakup.
His trembling, broken voice message arrived:
"You said... if I cry and beg, you’ll soften your heart."
"Look... I’m crying now... I’m begging you."
"Begging you... don’t throw me away like trash."
---
Later, in a dim room.
For three days and three nights, he pinched her waist in punishment:
"Waist... can be a little softer."

books.title: The Big Boss’s Little Wife
books.author: Lan Ya Lan
books.synopsis:
My cousin is a firm believer in remaining single. To get some peace and quiet, she begged Ling Ting to go on a blind date for her. Ling Ting went; although she thought the date was handsome and gentlemanly, she didn't give it much thought.
But what’s up with this new boss, who has a friendly smile and took the initiative to greet her?
He’s her blind date!
Ji Zhengyao: "Little comrade, we meet again."
Ling Ting: "...Hello, Boss."

books.title: My Fair Princess: The Pampered Imperial Concubine Chen and the Emperor’s Road to Redemption
books.author: Mo Qing Dai Ming
books.synopsis:
After transmigrating into the body of the Qianlong Emperor’s pampered Concubine Chen, she decided to just let it all go.
Jiang Rao opened her eyes to find herself as the most arrogant Concubine Chen in the harem, held in the palm of the Emperor’s hand, where he would give her the stars if she asked for the moon.
Until that day at the hunting grounds, when the Fifth Prince shot a girl with an arrow, and the Emperor tremblingly asked that question—
“Is your mother… Xia Yuhe?”
The grape in Jiang Rao’s hand went “plop” and fell.
Wait! Xia Yuhe from the banks of Daming Lake?!
Is this, for heaven’s sake, *My Fair Princess* (Huan Zhu Ge Ge)?!
Watching Xiao Yanzi enter the palace, Ziwei identify her father, and the Fragrant Concubine dance, the plot roared forward with great intensity.
Jiang Rao decisively chose: Eat melons, watch the show, and absolutely do not get involved!
But the Emperor insisted on provoking her—
“Rao’er, let me teach you how to read the memorials.”
“Rao’er, these pearls from the Southern Seas are only fit for you to wear.”
“Rao’er…”
Until the day Han Xiang entered the palace and the Emperor’s heart began to waver.
Jiang Rao sneered, packed her bags, and prepared to leave the palace: “Your Majesty, this concubine is tired.”
Qianlong finally panicked.
Later, the entire Forbidden City witnessed—
The Son of Heaven lurking outside Yongshou Palace every day:
“Rao’er, shall I tear down the Baoyue Pavilion?”
“Rao’er, look at the jasmine I just planted; doesn’t it look just like the one in your hair?”
“Rao’er… please don’t ignore me.”
Xiao Yanzi and the others were dumbfounded: So the pampered concubine was truly pampered, and the Emperor would actually kneel to win his wife back!

books.title: Wrongful Yearning
books.author: buxus
books.synopsis:
Everyone knows that the Seventh Prince, Xiao Cheng, is a good-for-nothing. The nobles of the capital despise him, and the powerful officials at court bully him.
Even the marriage bestowed by the Emperor was a calculated move: he was forced to marry Shen Li, a fierce daughter of a military family with achievements so great they threatened the throne and a temper as explosive as fire. It was called a favor, but it was actually surveillance.
On their wedding night, Shen Li looked at her timid husband with cold eyes, feeling nothing but disdain: "Coward."
She did not know that the sheep she was looking at had long since sharpened its fangs and had even prepared a private army capable of devouring the world.
Xiao Cheng had been biding his time for ten years, waiting only to be sent to his fiefdom so he could return to the sea like a dragon.
He used the Shen family’s influence to stabilize his fief; he used heavy gold to buy Su Wan, the daughter of a disgraced official, and took her as his strategist.
Su Wan understood his strategies and his ambitions; she was the resonance of his soul.
As for Shen Li, she only knew how to stand before him with a blade in hand, calling him a "good-for-nothing" while blocking fatal stray arrows for him.
Watching Shen Li covered in blood, a flicker of imperceptible pain flashed in Xiao Cheng's eyes, yet he turned and took Su Wan's hand instead.
He had clearly seen the burning heat beneath Shen Li's icy exterior, yet he chose to play deaf and dumb.
Because the path of an emperor cannot have a soft spot; and Shen Li, as it happened, was his most fatal weakness.
"I plotted for the world for your sake, yet you promised her a lifetime of splendor."
"Shen Li, I never said I loved you. It was you who chose to believe it."

books.title: Falling into the Emperor’s Embrace
books.author: Shan Shui Cheng Yue
books.synopsis:
When Gu Yuechan was six, she was betrothed to the second son of the Marquis of Changping.
After returning from mourning, the marriage, which had already been scheduled, suddenly encountered setbacks.
Rumor had it that the new Emperor had been deposed as Crown Prince due to the slanders of Noble Consort Zheng, and had lived in a Taoist temple for many years.
The current Marchioness of Changping naturally refused to let the daughter of the Zheng clan marry her son.
Relying on her beauty, Gu Yuechan would not accept such humiliation; she regrouped and set out to find a match even better than the Changping estate.
After much picking and choosing, she finally settled on the second son of the Duke of Ping.
Although he could not inherit the dukedom, he was young and obedient—enough for her to walk sideways in the capital (act with impunity).
However, on the very day of the betrothal, an imperial decree summoned her to the palace as a concubine.
Thinking of the cold-hearted new Emperor she had heard about from others, she hid and cried for several days.
She thought entering the palace was the new Emperor’s revenge, but the moment she saw him, Gu Yuechan blurted out: "Taoist priest."
Back when she was trying to resolve her family’s predicament, she had offered gold and silver to a Taoist priest, begging him to put in a good word for her father before the Sage.
The priest kept his word, and her father did indeed return to the imperial court.
The once ethereal priest was now dressed in black brocade, his face gloomy as he pinched her chin.
"If you want to walk sideways in the capital, why not come to my side?"

books.title: Escape with the Summer Wind
books.author: Peanut Tree
books.synopsis:
At fifteen, the boy, carrying the orange-gold summer wind, barged into Si Qing's world without warning.
Qi Fang came from a prominent family in the capital, wearing the skin of a carefree playboy, his gaze seemingly never lingering on anyone.
In her first year of university, a video of Si Qing giving a speech as a freshman representative was pinned to the top of the forum.
The girl was graceful and elegant, like a distant moon over the mountains, drawing admiration from all who saw her.
No one would ever associate the gentle, aloof little fairy with the indifferent young master who never took anything seriously.
Until later, someone witnessed the usually arrogant young master leaning against a windowsill, patiently braiding the little girl's hair.
---
In a hidden corner, the tall boy bent low before the girl, his eyes gentle, his fingertips lightly brushing her palm.
"Si Qing, look at me."
Qi Fang's voice, deep and smooth, coaxed softly, "Let's try, okay?"
"I'm yours to mold."
*
[In the third decade of snowfall, I was the first to covet the moon]
---
"I escape with the summer wind, waiting to meet you."
[Gentle, Sweet, and Good at Coaxing × Elegant Rascal Who Flirts and Acts Coy]

books.title: Tyrant Abuses Me? Turn Around and Collude with the Eunuch to Seize His Empire
books.author: Qing Shan You Ci
books.synopsis:
Xiang Jun entered the palace eight years ago, striving relentlessly, currying favor everywhere, yet she was still ground down, used, humiliated, and abandoned by the noble masters of the palace...
The nobles lounged in luxury atop piles of bones, mocking her desperate efforts and ignorance of her place.
In the end, the children she had fought to bear called another woman "Mother," and she was vivisected to take the child from her womb, dying with her eyes wide open in resentment.
After her death, only that cold and distant eunuch, whom she had met but a few times, gave her a proper burial, granting her the last shred of dignity.
Upon reawakening, Xiang Jun realized she was nothing more than a cannon fodder female antagonist in a story.
In this life, Xiang Jun would carve a different path for herself.
If those noble masters refused to treat them—those of lowly birth—as human, then she would conspire with the equally lowly eunuch, stirring up storms and turning the world upside down.
"Tingxue, in this life, let us be a pair of power-hungry, scheming villains—a treacherous eunuch and a bewitching concubine."

books.title: Espionage: Codename Tian Du Chao Feng
books.author: Zhuan Sheng
books.synopsis:
Shen Zhizhen went to a tomb with her professor,
only to be killed by a group of grave robbers who suddenly broke into the chamber.
When she opened her eyes again, not only had she become the descendant of a grave robber,
but she had also been branded as a little traitor...

books.title: Transmigrated as a Vicious Supporting Female Lead? The Male Lead Insists on Marrying Me!
books.author: Qi Bu Long Dong
books.synopsis: The moment Cui Mingyu opened her eyes, she found she had transmigrated into a novel as a vicious supporting female lead who was obsessed with love and constantly stirring up trouble. Seeing that she was on the verge of being loathed and purged by the male lead, she decisively pulled back from the brink and turned to look for a better match. But who would have thought that the male lead, who had previously looked at her with disdain, would start looking at her with an increasingly strange expression... Has he lost his mind?

books.title: Zero-Degree Ambiguity
books.author: Lan Sheng
books.synopsis:
One-sentence summary: I married my arch-nemesis.
　　In physics, zero degrees is a mixture of ice and water. Zero-degree ambiguity is the combination of ice and water—the perfect match in love.
　　Lingdu Design Company has two demons. Everyone in the company is terrified of them and knows full well how much they despise each other.
　　In fact, the dartboard on the wall in Design Director Wen Ni’s office is covered with photos of the same man.
　　Until they discover that these two are actually a secretly married couple in private.
　　Whoa, everyone realizes: so we were just a part of their "play"?
　　Thinking back, the way they looked at each other was never really innocent.
　　With the blinds drawn in the office, the woman is pressed against the edge of the desk, and the man leans in close: "I heard you want a divorce?"
　　The woman’s high heel slides up his suit trousers, her voice languid: "Whether we divorce or not, doesn't that depend on how you perform?"

books.title: Overly Wild
books.author: Niao Song Mi
books.synopsis:
Niao Song Mi's Cosmic Universe Series: Overly Wild

[Male lead steals love from his brother / Second male chases his wife to the crematorium, double purity][Fake obedient, truly rebellious little princess vs. scheming, cold, and seductive prince]

At the age of eight, Song Shuangxu was abandoned in an empty house to fend for herself. It was Shen Yu who took her in when no one else wanted her.

The boy in a school uniform and white shirt bent down to her: "Come with me, okay?"

From that day on, Shen Yu became her entire world.

Shen Yu doted on her, pampered her, and raised her like a princess. Unfortunately, she could only ever be his little sister.

Shuangxu watched as women came and went in his life, his playboy nature breaking her heart. Her secret feelings for him withered in the barren corners of her heart, growing into a field of wild grass.

In Shuangxu’s eyes, He Tingzhou was her brother’s friend, a terrible bastard, someone to avoid at all costs.

She never thought she would one day have an illicit relationship with He Tingzhou.

At a gathering, as the wine flowed and the atmosphere grew lively, in a darkened suite on the second floor, she was pinned against the door by a man, his kiss nearly suffocating her.
He Tingzhou bit her ear, lazily threatening, "If you don’t want your brother to hear, be good."

books.title: The Stand-in Bride Marries into the General’s Household
books.author: Yu Dan Feng Qing
books.synopsis:
In her past life, Yu Qingci refused to be a stand-in bride and was schemed by her stepmother into marrying a wolf in sheep’s clothing. After ten years of suffering, she perished alongside her in-laws. 

Reborn, Yu Qingci decides to accept the proposal to marry into the General’s Household as a stand-in for her elder sister, guarding the widow’s door. For she knows that in three years, the young general, rumored to have died in battle, will return safely.
The General’s Household rapidly declines after losing two generations of generals. 

After marrying in, Yu Qingci outsmarts her shameless relatives, protects her weak mother-in-law and sister-in-law, uses her past life’s memories to do business and accumulate wealth, and single-handedly revives the General’s Household.

Three years later, Young General Lu Yunqi returns with his confidante, earns great merits, and is honored by the court. The General’s Household soon regains its former glory...

books.title: The Great Song Dynasty Female Assassin (Hidden Shadows)
books.author: Xiu Tang
books.synopsis:
A modern elite assassin dies and returns to the Song Dynasty, becoming the formidable female assassin An Jiu. Injured during a mission, she encounters a kind and gentle girl named Mei Jiu. Mei Jiu is found by her long-lost mother, who also takes An Jiu with her.

After enrolling at the Mei Family Academy, An Jiu discovers numerous suspicious points, forcing her to conceal her abilities. Soon after, she uncovers the Mei family’s secret—training secret guards for the royal family (in reality, one of the Song Dynasty’s hidden assassin families). Meanwhile, she and Mei Jiu gradually go from misunderstanding each other to becoming good friends, and she also develops feelings for her martial arts teacher.

Just as things are going well, the Mei family is suddenly wiped out, and Mei Jiu is killed. An Jiu investigates the truth to avenge her friend and gradually becomes more and more involved in the vortex of conspiracy and love. At the same time, An Jiu also develops feelings for her master who taught her martial arts.

books.title: A Lady's Tranquility (Story of Kunning Palace)
books.author: Shi Jing

books.title: Rebirth Of The Female General
books.author: Qian Shan Cha Ke
books.synopsis:
The ancient saying goes: Most generals come from Guan Xi, while ministers come from Guan Dong.

He Yan was born to be a Star General.

She was merely a stepping stone for her family, and was used as her brother’s substitute. She had fought on the battlefields for years, bringing peace to Xi Qiang, stopping the barbarians… When her brother recovered, she gave up her position with great laurels brought to her name. Without further ado, she was married off.

During her married life, she was forsaken by her husband and even suffered from a strange illness, thereby losing her eyesight…

The young and pretty concubine stood in front of her, speaking softly: “The decoction you drank that made you blind was instructed by the elders of your family. As you know, the dead tell no tales. If you lived, you would be your family’s greatest threat!”

A great general of her time, the heroine of the country, died pitifully in the hands of those shameless women, who only knew to fight for a man’s favor… How absurd!

books.title: Daytime Lantern (Love Beyond The Grave)
books.author: Li Qing Ran
books.synopsis:
He Simu, the 400-year-old Ghost King, was scavenging for food on the battlefield when she unexpectedly found herself taken in.

The young general who took her in seemed to regard her as a weak orphan of war and treated her with great care.

He Simu then dutifully played the role of a weak woman.

— Oh, blood! I’m most afraid of blood, I faint at the sight of blood.
— The basin is so heavy, I’m so weak, I can’t lift it at all.
— You guys are always fighting and killing, it’s so scary!

The female warrior who secretly admired the young general retorted angrily, “Brother Duan doesn’t like delicate girls like you!”

He Simu tilted her head: “Is that so?”

books.title: Pursuit Of Jade
books.author: Tuan Zi Lai Xi
books.synopsis:
With her parents deceased, her childhood sweetheart’s engagement broken off, and relatives plotting to seize her family’s wealth, Fan Changyu decides to take in a son-in-law for the sake of her five-year-old sister. She sets her sights on the man she rescued; he is covered in wounds, possesses nothing, and is only handsome. They quickly agree on a deal: she will take him in to recover, and he will feign marriage to help her preserve her family fortune.

Once the family business is stable, Fan Changyu is about to write the divorce papers as agreed, but then the imperial court launches a war and conscripts soldiers. The man is taken away and disappears without a trace.

When she sees him again, he lies covered in blood in a wounded soldier’s tent, his face still handsome despite the blood, but his soldier’s uniform is tattered and mangled. Seeing his hardship in the army, Fan Changyu’s eyes reddened: “Don’t join the army anymore, go back home, I’ll slaughter pigs to support you.”

The man squinted, coughing up blood: “You want a divorce…”

Fan Changyu’s eyes brimmed with tears: “No, no!”

books.title: Offering Salted Fish To Master (When Destiny Brings The Demon)
books.author: Fu Hua
books.synopsis:
Liao Tingyan, a new disciple who had just started and had the lowest rank, got to be near the terrifying great master of Gengchen Xianfu, which caused a lot of discussions.

Shimei Liao, How did you do it?

Liao Tingyan: … By relying on the instinct of salted fish?

(Salted fish: people who have no intention of doing anything.)

books.title: Prisoner Of Beauty
books.author: Peng Lai Ke
books.synopsis:
She took her elder sister’s place, marrying into a family that had long been her own clan’s bitter enemy. From the moment Xiao Qiao stepped into the bridal sedan, she resigned herself to a life of solitude. As expected, Wei Shao never came to fetch her, and their wedding was carried out in haste. By the next morning, he was already planning to send her away.

She thought, at best, they would live out their days as polite strangers, bound by duty but distant at heart. Yet fate seemed determined to test them.

When she was kidnapped, he rode into battle, cutting down enemies in a rage to save her.
When she was framed by her mother-in-law, he stood firmly at her side, chastising even his own kin to shield her.

“You truly are a source of calamity.”
“And whose misfortune do I bring?”
“Mine—because you have ensnared my heart.”

books.title: Love In The Clouds
books.author: Bai Lu Cheng
books.synopsis:
He sees her as the perfect weapon. She sees him as her only cure.

Ji Bozai, a brilliant yet dangerous poison master, believes Mingyi is the finest sword he has ever forged—beautiful, deadly, and bound to him alone. To him, she is the blade that will cut down his enemies and the jewel that will crown his rise to power.

But Mingyi, once a ruthless warrior now dying from a slow, venomous curse, has her own plan. Disguised as a graceful dancer, she weaves a web of seduction to draw Ji Bozai close and steal the antidote that could save her life.

What begins as a battle of deceit and desire soon spirals into something neither can control. As love and hate intertwine, the two uncover a secret buried deep within a mythical fairyland—one that could destroy them both or bind their fates forever.

books.title: How dare you?
books.author: Qi Ying Jun
books.synopsis:
Wang Cuihua, an average office worker, was heading home when she unexpectedly transmigrated into a web novel. She found herself in the role of Yu Wanyin, a concubine of a tyrant. Coincidentally, that very night was Concubine Yu’s turn to attend His Majesty in his chambers.

When Yu Wanyin came face-to-face with the tyrant, something in his speech and demeanor struck her with an odd familiarity. After mulling it over, she decided to test her hunch.

“How are you?” she suddenly asked in English.

Xiahou Dan’s eyes grew red at the rims, and he remained silent for a moment.

Finally, he answered in English as well: “I’m fine, and you?”

books.title: Love And Crown
books.author: Xie Lounan
books.synopsis:
The court was rife with corruption and injustice, and turmoil was brewing across the land. The iron hooves of the north ignited flames of war, and the phoenix, perched atop its wutong tree, never returned. Survival and destruction hung in the balance—dark clouds obscured the moon, the world was tainted, the light of day was dimmed, and the golden age was in peril.

He, with his frail body, poured out his heart and soul and, with a wave of his hand, brought peace and order to the corrupt world. Finally, the clouds parted, the winds cleared, and the sun and moon shone brightly once more.

He was the emperor of the Great Wu, and she was his empress.

She never told anyone that the fate of the nation, the fleeting years, could never compare to his smile in the autumn breeze of Jiangnan.

books.title: Inverse-Time Investigation Team (Mobius)
books.author: Zhang Xiaomao
books.synopsis:
The Inverse Time Investigation Team is composed of elite criminal police, cutting-edge scientists, criminologists, and network experts. It is a secret task force established to target criminal groups with extremely strong anti-investigation capabilities and that possess cutting-edge technologies such as time reversal, artificial intelligence, gene editing, and big data information.

One day, criminal police officer Lu Tianfeng discovered he possessed the ability to replay time, allowing him to relive the same day five times at irregular intervals. Relying on this ability, Lu Tianfeng repeatedly returned to the events leading to the investigation, solving one serious case after another. It wasn’t until a murder notice from suspect X suddenly appeared that Lu Tianfeng gradually realized he wasn’t the only one possessing this ability…

books.title: Starting Point (Reset)
books.author: Qi Dao Jun
books.synopsis:
Li Shiqing gets on a bus, expecting to reach her destination as usual, but instead embarks on a journey of death in an infinite time loop. After repeatedly experiencing death on the bus, the heroine is on the verge of collapse and tries to get off the bus, thus dragging her co-star Xiao Heyun into the time loop as well. After all their attempts, they decide to find out who is behind all this and end the time loop on the bus.

A time loop mystery set on a bus, the hero and heroine try everything they can to save the lives of the bus and to stop the time loop. For the reader, this is both a suspenseful escape room novel and a self-help guide for ordinary people who are “stuck for a day”, combining the thrill of an “infinite stream” prophet with the excitement of suspense.
